name: Rumbi Island Grill (Logan) Luau Pork or Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl (White Rice Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Rumbi Island Grill (Logan & Utah County, UT)
whyItWorks: Rumbi lets you swap the beans-and-rice base for 100% steamed white rice, topped with tender slow-roasted Kalua Luau Pork or grilled chicken breast and cooked carrots/broccoli florets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Regular or Little Kahuna Rice Bowl with Luau Pork or Grilled Chicken on 100% steamed white rice (no Rumbi black-bean rice), light teriyaki sauce on the side, and no raw cabbage.
watchOuts: Default "Rumbi Rice" contains whole black beans—always request plain steamed white rice instead; avoid spicy Jamaican Jerk and Volcano sauces
